name: ZenHR
description:
ZenHR is the leading AI-powered HR platform built specifically for organizations across the Middle East and North Africa.

ZenHR is more than just HR software; it allows you to connect workforce data with Claude to help organizations transform HR information into actionable insights, recommendations, reports, and executive-ready presentations. By combining HR management, workforce management, payroll, performance management, employee data, attendance, leave management, and HR analytics in one intelligent platform, ZenHR enables businesses to make faster, smarter workforce decisions.

Through a growing library of AI skills, HR teams can instantly generate workforce reports, analyze performance trends, monitor Saudization targets, uncover workforce insights, answer HR questions, and create executive presentations using real-time HR data.

Built for the region and fully localized across multiple MENA countries, ZenHR understands local labor laws, payroll regulations, compliance requirements, and workforce challenges. As new AI skills continue to be introduced - including but not limited to: workforce planning, succession planning, employee retention analysis, talent intelligence, compensation insights, and predictive workforce analytics - ZenHR is evolving into the AI operating layer for workforce management in the region.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ZenHR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ZenHR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.zenhr.com/zen_mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ZenHR MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZenHR provides these MCP tools: get_hr_updates, get_my_profile, get_nitaqat_guideline, get_nitaqat_workforce, get_pe_bell_curve_data, get_team_timeoff, list_branches, list_employees, and summarize_financial_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ZenHR?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ZenHR in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
ZenHR requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ZenHR is developed by ZenHR Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
